   475	        model=config["sentdhio"]["dna_scope_snv_model"],
   476	        use_threads=config["sentdhio"]["use_threads"],
   477	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   478	    shell:
   479	        r"""
   480	        set -euo pipefail
   481	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   482	
   483	        timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S);
   484	        export TMPDIR="/dev/shm/sentdhiom_s1_${{timestamp}}_$$";
   485	        export SENTIEON_TMPDIR="$TMPDIR";
   486	        mkdir -p "$TMPDIR";
   487	        if [ ! -d "$TMPDIR" ]; then
   488	            echo "ERROR: Failed to create TMPDIR: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   489	            exit 5;
   490	        fi
   491	        echo "TMPDIR created: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   492	        ls -ld "$TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   493	        df -h /dev/shm >> {log} 2>&1;
   494	        export APPTAINER_HOME="$TMPDIR";
   495	        trap "rm -rf \\"$TMPDIR\\" || echo 'TMPDIR rm fails' >> {log} 2>&1" EXIT;

   498	
   499	        # Use cluster_sample for consistent @RG SM tag across entire pipeline
   500	        # This matches the pattern used in sentieon_bwa_sort and other alignment rules
   501	        epocsec=$(date +%s)
   502	
   503	        # Check if merged_diff.bed is empty - if so, skip HAP_CMD and create empty outputs
   504	        if [ ! -s {input.diff_bed} ]; then
   505	            echo "WARNING: merged_diff.bed is empty - no haplotype regions to process" >> {log}
   506	            echo "Creating empty hap_bam (with clean header), hap_bed, hap_vcf files" >> {log}
   507	            # Create empty BED and VCF
   508	            touch {output.hap_bed} {output.hap_vcf}
   509	            # Create proper empty BAM with clean header: @HD, @SQ, and @RG lines only (no @PG)
   510	            # Include @RG because sentieon driver requires it
   511	            # Exclude @PG to avoid PP chain references to non-existent programs
   512	            samtools view -H {input.lr_cram} | grep -E '^@(HD|SQ|RG)' | samtools view -bo {output.hap_bam} -
   513	            samtools index {output.hap_bam}

   515	            # Only run insertion detection (no interval restriction)
   516	            INS_CMD="sentieon driver -r {params.huref} -t {params.use_threads} \
   517	                -i {input.lr_cram} \
   518	                --algo HybridStage1 \
   519	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1_ins.model \
   520	                --fa_file {output.ins_fa} \
   521	                --bed_file {output.ins_bed} \
   522	                -"

   524	            $INS_CMD 2>> {log} | \
   525	            sentieon bwa mem \
   526	                -R "@RG\\tID:{params.cluster_sample}-$epocsec\\tSM:{params.cluster_sample}\\tLB:{params.cluster_sample}-LB-1\\tPL:HYBRID" \
   527	                -t {params.use_threads} \
   528	                -x {params.model}/HybridStage1_bwa.model \
   529	                {params.huref} - 2>> {log} | \
   530	            sentieon util sort \
   531	                -i - -t {params.use_threads} \
   532	                -o {output.bam} --sam2bam >> {log} 2>&1
   533	        else
   534	            echo "Processing $(wc -l < {input.diff_bed}) regions from merged_diff.bed" >> {log}
   535	
   536	            # Haplotype assembly driver command
   537	            HAP_CMD="sentieon driver -r {params.huref} -t {params.use_threads} \
   538	                -i {input.lr_cram} --interval {input.diff_bed} \
   539	                --algo HybridStage1 \
   540	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1.model \
   541	                --hap_bam {output.hap_bam} \
   542	                --hap_bed {output.hap_bed} \
   543	                --hap_vcf {output.hap_vcf} \
   544	                -"
   545	
   546	            # Insertion detection driver command
   547	            INS_CMD="sentieon driver -r {params.huref} -t {params.use_threads} \
   548	                -i {input.lr_cram} \
   549	                --algo HybridStage1 \
   550	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1_ins.model \
   551	                --fa_file {output.ins_fa} \
   552	                --bed_file {output.ins_bed} \
   553	                -"
   554	
   555	            # Cat both FASTQ streams → bwa mem → util sort
   556	            cat <($HAP_CMD 2>> {log}) <($INS_CMD 2>> {log}) | \
   557	            sentieon bwa mem \
   558	                -R "@RG\\tID:{params.cluster_sample}-$epocsec\\tSM:{params.cluster_sample}\\tLB:{params.cluster_sample}-LB-1\\tPL:HYBRID" \
   559	                -t {params.use_threads} \

   562	            sentieon util sort \
   563	                -i - -t {params.use_threads} \
   564	                -o {output.bam} --sam2bam >> {log} 2>&1
   565	        fi
   566	
   567	        echo "Stage 1 completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   568	        """

   867	# Rule 14: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   868	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   869	rule sentdhiom_transfer:
   870	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   871	    input:
   872	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   873	    output:
   874	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   875	    wildcard_constraints:
   876	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHIOM)
   877	    log:
   878	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   879	    threads: config['sentdhio']['threads']
   880	    conda:
   881	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   882	    resources:
   883	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   884	        threads=192,
   885	        vcpu=192,
   886	        mem_mb=config['sentdhio']['mem_mb'],
   887	    params:
   888	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhio"]["pop_vcf"],
   889	        use_threads=config["sentdhio"]["use_threads"],
   890	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   891	    shell:
   892	        """
   893	        set -euo pipefail
   894	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   895	
   896	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   897	
   898	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   899	
   900	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   901	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   902	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   903	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   904	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   905	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   906	
   907	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   908	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   909	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   910	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   911	
   912	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   913	
   914	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   915	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   916	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   917	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   918	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   919	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   920	
   921	            # Create tabix index
   922	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   923	
   924	            # Cleanup temp files
   925	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" \
   926	                  "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   927	        else
   928	            echo "No pop_vcf configured, using reheadered anno VCF directly" >> {log}
   929	            mv "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {output.vcf}
   930	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   931	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   932	        fi
   933	
   934	        echo "Transfer completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   935	        """

   758	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   759	# Rule 13: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   760	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   761	rule sentdhuom_transfer:
   762	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   763	    input:
   764	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhuom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   765	    output:
   766	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhuom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   767	    wildcard_constraints:
   768	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHUOM)
   769	    log:
   770	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhuom/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   771	    threads: config['sentdhuo']['threads']
   772	    conda:
   773	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   774	    resources:
   775	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   776	        threads=192,
   777	        vcpu=192,
   778	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
   779	    params:
   780	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhuo"]["pop_vcf"],
   781	        use_threads=config["sentdhuo"]["use_threads"],
   782	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   783	    shell:
   784	        """
   785	        set -euo pipefail
   786	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   787	
   788	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   789	
   790	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   791	
   792	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   793	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   794	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   795	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   796	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   797	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   798	
   799	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   800	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   801	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   802	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   803	
   804	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   805	
   806	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   807	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   808	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   809	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   810	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   811	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   812	
   813	            # Create tabix index
   814	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   815	
   816	            # Cleanup temp files
   817	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" \
   818	                  "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   819	        else
   820	            echo "No pop_vcf configured, using reheadered anno VCF directly" >> {log}
   821	            mv "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {output.vcf}
   822	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   823	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   824	        fi
   825	
   826	        echo "Transfer completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   827	        """

   361	        r"""
   362	        set -euo pipefail

   364	
   365	        timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S);

   367	        export SENTIEON_TMPDIR="$TMPDIR";
   368	        mkdir -p "$TMPDIR";
   369	        if [ ! -d "$TMPDIR" ]; then
   370	            echo "ERROR: Failed to create TMPDIR: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;

   372	        fi
   373	        echo "TMPDIR created: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   374	        ls -ld "$TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;

   383	        epocsec=$(date +%s)

   386	        if [ ! -s {input.diff_bed} ]; then
   387	            echo "WARNING: merged_diff.bed is empty - no haplotype regions to process" >> {log}

   394	            samtools view -H {input.pb_cram} | grep -E '^@(HD|SQ|RG)' | samtools view -bo {output.hap_bam} -

   409	                -t {params.use_threads} \

   431	                --algo HybridStage1 \
   432	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1_ins.model \
   433	                --fa_file {output.ins_fa} \
   434	                --bed_file {output.ins_bed} \
   435	                -"
   436	
   437	            # Cat both FASTQ streams → bwa mem → util sort
   438	            cat <($HAP_CMD 2>> {log}) <($INS_CMD 2>> {log}) | \
   439	            sentieon bwa mem \
   440	                -R "@RG\\tID:{params.cluster_sample}-$epocsec\\tSM:{params.cluster_sample}\\tLB:{params.cluster_sample}-LB-1\\tPL:HYBRID" \
   441	                -t {params.use_threads} \

   446	                -o {output.bam} --sam2bam >> {log} 2>&1
   447	        fi

   449	        echo "Stage 1 completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   450	        """

   745	# Rule 13: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   746	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   747	rule sentdhupm_transfer:
   748	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   749	    input:
   750	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   751	    output:
   752	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   753	    wildcard_constraints:
   754	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHUPM)
   755	    log:
   756	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   757	    threads: config['sentdhuo']['threads']
   758	    conda:
   759	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   760	    resources:
   761	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   762	        threads=192,
   763	        vcpu=192,
   764	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
   765	    params:
   766	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhuo"]["pop_vcf"],
   767	        use_threads=config["sentdhuo"]["use_threads"],
   768	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   769	    shell:
   770	        """
   771	        set -euo pipefail
   772	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   773	
   774	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   775	
   776	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   777	
   778	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   779	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   780	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   781	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   782	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   783	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   784	
   785	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   786	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   787	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   788	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   789	
   790	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   791	
   792	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   793	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   794	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   795	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   796	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   797	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   798	
   799	            # Create tabix index
   800	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   801	
   802	            # Cleanup temp files
   803	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" \
   804	                  "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   805	        else
   806	            echo "No pop_vcf configured, using reheadered anno VCF directly" >> {log}
   807	            mv "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {output.vcf}
   808	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   809	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   810	        fi
   811	
   812	        echo "Transfer completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   813	        """

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replace hardcoded threads=192 and vcpu=192 in resources sections with config refs."""
import re

# Mapping: filename -> config key
FILE_CONFIG = {
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk": "sentdhio",
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk": "sentdhuo",
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk": "sentdhuo",
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_pb_modular.smk": "sentdhipm",
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk": "sentdhrom",
    "workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk": "sentdhrpm",
}

total_replacements = 0

for filepath, config_key in FILE_CONFIG.items():
    with open(filepath, "r") as f:
        content = f.read()

    original = content
    replacement = f"config['{config_key}']['threads']"

    # Pattern 1: threads=192, in resources (with possible leading whitespace)
    new_content, n1 = re.subn(
        r"([ \t]+)threads=192,",
        rf"\1threads={replacement},",
        content,
    )

    # Pattern 2: vcpu=192, in resources
    new_content, n2 = re.subn(
        r"([ \t]+)vcpu=192,",
        rf"\1vcpu={replacement},",
        new_content,
    )

    file_count = n1 + n2
    total_replacements += file_count

    if new_content != original:
        with open(filepath, "w") as f:
            f.write(new_content)
        print(f"  {filepath}: {n1} threads= + {n2} vcpu= = {file_count} replacements")
    else:
        print(f"  {filepath}: NO CHANGES (unexpected)")

print(f"\nTotal replacements: {total_replacements}")

echo ""
echo "=== SLURM QUEUE ==="
$SSH "squeue -u ubuntu --format='%.8i %.2t %.55j %.10M' 2>/dev/null | head -25"

echo ""

"""
Annotation transfer functionality
"""

import pathlib
import re
import subprocess as sp
import tempfile
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from importlib_resources import files

from . import command_strings as cmds
from .job import Job
from .logging import get_logger
from .shard import Shard

logger = get_logger(__name__)


def build_transfer_jobs(
    out_vcf: pathlib.Path,
    pop_vcf: pathlib.Path,
    raw_vcf: pathlib.Path,
    base_tmp_dir: pathlib.Path,
    shards: List[Shard],
    pop_vcf_contigs: Dict[str, Optional[int]],
    fai_data: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]],
    dry_run: bool = False,
    cores: int = 1,
) -> Tuple[List[Job], Job]:
    """Transfer annotations from the pop_vcf to the raw_vcf"""

    # Get a unique tmpdir
    tmp_dir_str = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=base_tmp_dir)
    tmp_dir = pathlib.Path(tmp_dir_str)

    # Generate merge rules from the population VCF
    merge_rules = "AC_v20:sum,AF_v20:sum,AC_genomes:sum,AF_genomes:sum"
    if not dry_run:
        kvpat = re.compile(r'(.*?)=(".*?"|.*?)(?:,|$)')
        cmd = ["bcftools", "view", "-h", str(pop_vcf)]
        p = sp.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        id_fields: List[str] = []
        for line in p.stdout.split("\n"):
            if not line.startswith("##INFO"):
                continue
            if ",Number=A" not in line:
                continue
            s = line.index("<")
            e = line.index(">")
            d = dict(kvpat.findall(line[s + 1 : e]))  # noqa: E203
            id_fields.append(d["ID"])
        merge_rules = ",".join([x + ":sum" for x in id_fields])

echo "========== STEP 1: Clone repos =========="
for name in $HCIO $HMIO $HCUO $HMUO; do
    if [ -d "$BASE/$name/daylily-omics-analysis" ]; then
        echo "SKIP: $name already exists"
    else
        echo "Cloning $name on branch $BRANCH ..."
        day-clone -d "$name" -t "$BRANCH"
    fi

    src="${pair##*:}"
    echo "Copying config from $src -> $dst"
    cp "$BASE/$src/daylily-omics-analysis/config/samples.tsv" \
       "$BASE/$dst/daylily-omics-analysis/config/samples.tsv"
    cp "$BASE/$src/daylily-omics-analysis/config/units.tsv" \
       "$BASE/$dst/daylily-omics-analysis/config/units.tsv"
done

for s in $HCIO $HMIO $HCUO $HMUO; do
    tmux kill-session -t "$s" 2>/dev/null || true
done

tmux new-session -d -s "$HCIO"
sleep 1
tmux send-keys -t "$HCIO" "cd $BASE/$HCIO/daylily-omics-analysis && source ~/.bashrc && . dyoainit --project $HCIO && dy-a slurm hg38 && dy-r produce_snv_concordances -p -k -j 300" Enter

echo "========== All 4 sessions launched =========="
tmux ls
echo "Done."
SCRIPT_EOF

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/jmajor/projects/daylily/daylily-omics-analysis

echo "=== GIT STATUS ==="
git status --short workflow/rules/

echo "=== GIT ADD ==="
git add \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_pb_modular.smk \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk

echo "=== GIT COMMIT ==="
git commit -m "fix: reheader LR+stage3 BAMs before DNAscope pass1/pass2 for single-sample VCFs

Modular pipeline was feeding BAMs with mismatched SM tags to sentieon driver,
producing multi-sample VCFs that caused Duplicated sample name errors in
the transfer step. Now reheaders LR CRAM and stage3 BAM to use cluster_sample
SM tag before DNAscope calls, matching sentieon-cli --rgsm/--replace_rg behavior.

Files: ilmn_ont(pass1+pass2), ilmn_pb(pass1+pass2), roche_ont(pass2),
roche_pb(pass2), ug_pb(pass2). ug_ont already fixed in commit 9426248."

echo "=== GIT PUSH ==="
git push origin feat/modular-hybrid-workflows

echo "=== DONE ==="
git log --oneline -3

   898	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   899	# Rule 14: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   900	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   901	rule sentdhiom_transfer:
   902	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   903	    input:
   904	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   905	    output:
   906	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   907	    wildcard_constraints:
   908	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHIOM)
   909	    log:
   910	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   911	    threads: config['sentdhio']['threads']
   912	    conda:
   913	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   914	    resources:
   915	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   916	        threads=config['sentdhio']['threads'],
   917	        vcpu=config['sentdhio']['threads'],
   918	        mem_mb=config['sentdhio']['mem_mb'],
   919	    params:
   920	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhio"]["pop_vcf"],
   921	        use_threads=config["sentdhio"]["use_threads"],
   922	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   923	    shell:
   924	        """
   925	        set -euo pipefail
   926	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   927	
   928	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   929	
   930	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   931	
   932	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   933	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   934	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   935	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   936	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   937	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   938	
   939	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   940	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   941	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   942	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   943	
   944	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   945	
   946	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   947	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   948	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   949	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   950	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   951	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   952	
   953	            # Create tabix index
   954	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1

set -euo pipefail

cd /Users/jmajor/projects/daylily/daylily-omics-analysis

git add \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk \

  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk \
  workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk

git commit -m "feat: add --replace_rg with LR:1 tag to remaining 4 modular hybrid workflows

Replace samtools reheader approach with sentieon driver --replace_rg
in pass1, mapq0, stage3, and pass2 rules for:
- sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk
- sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk
- sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk
- sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk

The LR:1 readgroup tag is critical for the hybrid.model to distinguish
long reads from short reads. Without it, indel precision drops from
~0.97 (CLI) to ~0.63 (modular). This matches the CLI behavior exactly.

Also removes temporary BAM creation/indexing/cleanup, improving
performance by avoiding full BAM copies."

git push origin feat/modular-hybrid-workflows

echo "=== Push complete ==="
git log --oneline -3

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

HEADNODE="44.231.76.175"
PEM="$HOME/.ssh/lsmc-omics-us-west-2.pem"
SSH="ssh -i $PEM -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=30 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 ubuntu@${HEADNODE}"

echo "=== Step 1: Clone t5-mod-ilmn-ont-3x ==="
$SSH "bash -l -c 'day-clone -t feat/modular-hybrid-workflows -w ssh -d t5-mod-ilmn-ont-3x 2>&1 | tail -5'"

echo ""
echo "=== Step 2: Clone t5-mod-ug-ont-3x ==="
$SSH "bash -l -c 'day-clone -t feat/modular-hybrid-workflows -w ssh -d t5-mod-ug-ont-3x 2>&1 | tail -5'"

echo ""
echo "=== Step 3: Verify clones ==="
$SSH "cd /fsx/analysis_results/ubuntu/t5-mod-ilmn-ont-3x/daylily-omics-analysis && git log --oneline -1 && echo '---' && cd /fsx/analysis_results/ubuntu/t5-mod-ug-ont-3x/daylily-omics-analysis && git log --oneline -1"

echo ""
echo "=== Step 4: Launch Modular ILMN+ONT (hg38) ==="
$SSH "tmux new-session -d -s t5-mod-ilmn-ont && \
  tmux send-keys -t t5-mod-ilmn-ont 'cd /fsx/analysis_results/ubuntu/t5-mod-ilmn-ont-3x/daylily-omics-analysis && source ~/.bashrc && . dyoainit --project t5-mod-ilmn-ont-3x && dy-a slurm hg38 && dy-r produce_sentdhiom_vcf -p -k -j 50 2>&1 | tee /tmp/t5-mod-ilmn-ont.log' Enter"

echo ""
echo "=== Step 5: Launch Modular UG+ONT (hg38_broad) ==="
$SSH "tmux new-session -d -s t5-mod-ug-ont && \
  tmux send-keys -t t5-mod-ug-ont 'cd /fsx/analysis_results/ubuntu/t5-mod-ug-ont-3x/daylily-omics-analysis && source ~/.bashrc && . dyoainit --project t5-mod-ug-ont-3x && dy-a slurm hg38_broad && dy-r produce_sentdhuom_vcf -p -k -j 50 2>&1 | tee /tmp/t5-mod-ug-ont.log' Enter"

echo ""
echo "=== Step 6: Verify tmux sessions ==="
sleep 3
$SSH "tmux ls 2>/dev/null | grep t5-mod"

echo ""
echo "=== Done ==="

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os

content = """# Process & Terminal Timeout Rules

## The Problem
Using wait=true with long max_wait_seconds on read-process or launch-process blocks the agent. The user then cancels the tool call, the tool marks the terminal as killed, and the agent loses the handle -- even though the underlying process (e.g., SSH session) is still alive. This leads to:
- Repeated reconnections to the same host
- Wasted time and money
- Frustrated users

## Rules

### 1. max_wait_seconds ceiling
- **NEVER** set max_wait_seconds above **15 seconds** for launch-process with wait=true.
- **NEVER** set max_wait_seconds above **5 seconds** for read-process with wait=true.
- If a command is expected to take longer than 15 seconds, use wait=false and poll later.

### 2. No sleep in tool timeout -- embed it in the command instead
- **WRONG**: launch-process(command="sleep 30 && ssh ... check status", wait=true, max_wait_seconds=45)
- **RIGHT**: launch-process(command="ssh ... 'sleep 10 && check status'", wait=true, max_wait_seconds=15)
- Even better: just run the check immediately. If the result is not ready, tell the user and offer to check again later.

### 3. Prefer single-shot SSH over interactive sessions
- For remote commands, prefer `ssh host "command"` with wait=true and short timeout.
- Only use interactive SSH sessions (wait=false) when you genuinely need a persistent shell (rare).
- If an interactive session dies or gets marked killed, do NOT reopen it -- switch to single-shot commands.

### 4. Polling async work
- Sleep embedded inside the SSH command is fine: `ssh host "sleep 5 && tail -20 /tmp/log"`
- But keep total expected wall time under 15 seconds.
- If you need to wait longer, tell the user: "The job is still running. Let me know when you'd like me to check again."

### 5. read-process specifically
- Default to wait=false for read-process. Only use wait=true if you are certain the process will finish within 5 seconds.
- If read-process returns empty or partial output with wait=false, that is fine -- report what you have.

### 6. Never re-open what is already open
- If a terminal gets marked killed by the tool but the underlying process is still alive (e.g., SSH, tmux), do NOT open a new interactive session. Use single-shot commands instead.
"""

path = os.path.expanduser("~/.augment/rules/12_process_timeout.md")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("WRITTEN to", path)

# Process & Terminal Timeout Rules

## The Problem
Using wait=true with long max_wait_seconds on read-process or launch-process blocks the agent. The user then cancels the tool call, the tool marks the terminal as killed, and the agent loses the handle -- even though the underlying process (e.g., SSH session) is still alive. This leads to:
- Repeated reconnections to the same host
- Wasted time and money
- Frustrated users

## Rules

### 1. max_wait_seconds ceiling
- **NEVER** set max_wait_seconds above **15 seconds** for launch-process with wait=true.
- **NEVER** set max_wait_seconds above **5 seconds** for read-process with wait=true.
- If a command is expected to take longer than 15 seconds, use wait=false and poll later.

### 2. No sleep in tool timeout -- embed it in the command instead
- **WRONG**: launch-process(command="sleep 30 && ssh ... check status", wait=true, max_wait_seconds=45)
- **RIGHT**: launch-process(command="ssh ... 'sleep 10 && check status'", wait=true, max_wait_seconds=15)
- Even better: just run the check immediately. If the result is not ready, tell the user and offer to check again later.

Instead, these resource values should be dynamically set using the same config-based approach used for the rule-level `threads:` directive. Specifically:

1. The `resources: threads=` value should reference the appropriate config key (e.g., `config['sentdhio']['threads']` for the `sentdhio` rules, `config['sentdhuo']['threads']` for `sentdhuo` rules, etc.)
2. The `resources: vcpu=` value should also reference the same config key, since vcpu should match the thread count

   - `sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk` (uses `sentdhio` config)
   - `sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk` (uses `sentdhuo` config)

   - `sent_hybrid_ilmn_pb_modular.smk` (uses `sentdhipm` config)
   - `sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk` (uses `sentdhrom` config)
   - `sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk` (uses `sentdhrpm` config)

This ensures that thread/vcpu counts can be controlled via the config files (`config/day_profiles/local/templates/rule_config.yaml` and `config/day_profiles/slurm/templates/rule_config.yaml`) rather than being hardcoded in the rule definitions.

   866	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   867	# Rule 14: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   868	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   869	rule sentdhiom_transfer:
   870	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   871	    input:
   872	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   873	    output:
   874	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   875	    wildcard_constraints:
   876	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHIOM)
   877	    log:
   878	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhiom/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   879	    threads: config['sentdhio']['threads']
   880	    conda:
   881	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   882	    resources:
   883	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   884	        threads=192,
   885	        vcpu=192,
   886	        mem_mb=config['sentdhio']['mem_mb'],
   887	    params:
   888	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhio"]["pop_vcf"],
   889	        use_threads=config["sentdhio"]["use_threads"],
   890	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   891	    shell:
   892	        """
   893	        set -euo pipefail
   894	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   895	
   896	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   897	
   898	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   899	
   900	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   901	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   902	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   903	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   904	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   905	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   906	
   907	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   908	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   909	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   910	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   911	
   912	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   913	
   914	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   915	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   916	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   917	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   918	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   919	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   920	
   921	            # Create tabix index
   922	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   923	
   924	            # Cleanup temp files
   925	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" \
   926	                  "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   927	        else
   928	            echo "No pop_vcf configured, using reheadered anno VCF directly" >> {log}
   929	            mv "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {output.vcf}
   930	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   931	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   932	        fi
   933	
   934	        echo "Transfer completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   935	        """

   361	        r"""
   362	        set -euo pipefail
   363	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   364	
   365	        timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S);
   366	        export TMPDIR="/dev/shm/sentdhuom_s1_${{timestamp}}_$$";
   367	        export SENTIEON_TMPDIR="$TMPDIR";
   368	        mkdir -p "$TMPDIR";
   369	        if [ ! -d "$TMPDIR" ]; then
   370	            echo "ERROR: Failed to create TMPDIR: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   371	            exit 5;
   372	        fi
   373	        echo "TMPDIR created: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   374	        ls -ld "$TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   375	        df -h /dev/shm >> {log} 2>&1;
   376	        export APPTAINER_HOME="$TMPDIR";

   382	        # This matches the pattern used in sentieon_bwa_sort and other alignment rules
   383	        epocsec=$(date +%s)

   385	        # Check if merged_diff.bed is empty - if so, skip HAP_CMD and create empty outputs
   386	        if [ ! -s {input.diff_bed} ]; then
   387	            echo "WARNING: merged_diff.bed is empty - no haplotype regions to process" >> {log}
   388	            echo "Creating empty hap_bam (with clean header), hap_bed, hap_vcf files" >> {log}
   389	            # Create empty BED and VCF
   390	            touch {output.hap_bed} {output.hap_vcf}

   392	            # Include @RG because sentieon driver requires it

   394	            samtools view -H {input.ont_cram} | grep -E '^@(HD|SQ|RG)' | samtools view -bo {output.hap_bam} -

   401	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1_ins.model \

   409	                -t {params.use_threads} \

   411	                {params.huref} - 2>> {log} | \
   412	            sentieon util sort \
   413	                -i - -t {params.use_threads} \
   414	                -o {output.bam} --sam2bam >> {log} 2>&1
   415	        else

   418	            # Haplotype assembly driver command

   430	                -i {input.ont_cram} \
   431	                --algo HybridStage1 \
   432	                --model {params.model}/HybridStage1_ins.model \
   433	                --fa_file {output.ins_fa} \
   434	                --bed_file {output.ins_bed} \
   435	                -"
   436	
   437	            # Cat both FASTQ streams → bwa mem → util sort
   438	            cat <($HAP_CMD 2>> {log}) <($INS_CMD 2>> {log}) | \
   439	            sentieon bwa mem \
   440	                -R "@RG\\tID:{params.cluster_sample}-$epocsec\\tSM:{params.cluster_sample}\\tLB:{params.cluster_sample}-LB-1\\tPL:HYBRID" \

   447	        fi

   450	        """

     5	discrete Snakemake rules for better observability, restartability, and debugging.
     6	
     7	Caller code: sentdhupm (Sentieon DNAscope Hybrid Ultima+PacBio Modular)
     8	
     9	Pipeline stages (21 discrete rules):
    10	1. Pass 1: Initial DNAscope on combined Ultima + PacBio reads
    11	2. Hybrid Select: Region selection from pass-1 VCF
    12	3. MAPQ0 Detection: Find low-quality mapping regions
    13	4. MAPQ0 Slop: Extend MAPQ0 regions by 1000bp
    14	5. Merge BEDs: Combine selected + MAPQ0 regions
    15	6. Stage 1: Insertion detection + haplotype assembly → bwa realign
    16	7. Stage 2: Generate unmap/alt BAMs and refined BED
    17	8. Stage 3: Re-alignment with stage2 outputs
    18	9. Pass 2: Second-pass variant calling on refined regions
    19	10. Subset: Subset pass-1 VCF to complement of stage2 regions
    20	11. Concat: Concatenate subset + pass2 VCFs
    21	12. Anno: Hybrid-specific annotations
    22	13. Transfer: Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
    23	14. Model Apply: DNAModelApply ML filtering
    24	15. Final Norm: bcftools normalization → output VCF
    25	
    26	Key differences from Illumina+ONT (sentdhiom):
    27	- Uses pre-aligned Ultima CRAM (`--sr_aln`) - NO FASTQ alignment step
    28	- Uses ALIGNERS_DHUPM = ["ug"] for wildcard constraints
    29	- Uses get_alt_sample_name for sample name extraction
    30	- Uses HybridUltimaPacBio model bundle
    31	- References hg38_broad instead of standard hg38
    32	
    33	References:
    34	- sentieon-cli/workflow/Snakefile (lines 390-815)
    35	- sentieon-cli/sentieon_cli/dnascope_hybrid.py (call_variants method)
    36	- sentieon-cli/sentieon_cli/command_strings.py
    37	"""
    38	
    39	import sys
    40	import os
    41	
    42	# Aligner constraint for Ultima+PacBio hybrid modular workflow
    43	ALIGNERS_DHUPM = ["ug"]

    46	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    63	    log:

    71	    resources:

    73	        threads=192,
    74	        vcpu=192,
    75	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
    76	    params:

    81	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,

    83	    shell:
    84	        """

    97	        ls -ld "$TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;

    99	        export APPTAINER_HOME="$TMPDIR";
   100	        trap "rm -rf \\"$TMPDIR\\" || echo 'TMPDIR rm fails' >> {log} 2>&1" EXIT;
   101	
   102	        echo "Starting Pass 1 DNAscope (Ultima+PacBio) at $(date)" >> {log}
   103	
   104	        # Validate Ultima CRAM
   105	        echo "Validating Ultima CRAM: {input.ug_cram}" >> {log} 2>&1
   106	        samtools quickcheck -v {input.ug_cram} >> {log} 2>&1
   107	        _sq_count=$(samtools view -H {input.ug_cram} 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^@SQ' || true)

   113	        _sq_count_pb=$(samtools view -H {input.pb_cram} 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^@SQ' || true)

   116	        # Reheader input CRAMs to use consistent sample name (cluster_sample)

   119

   146	        """

   149	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   150	# Rule 2: Hybrid Select - Region selection from pass-1 VCF
   151	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   152	rule sentdhupm_hybrid_select:
   153	    """Select regions for hybrid re-analysis based on pass-1 variants.
   154	
   155	    This replicates the sentieon-cli hybrid_select pipeline:
   156	    1. hybrid_select.py filters VCF based on long/short read confidence
   157	    2. bcftools view filters for PASS variants
   158	    3. bcftools query converts to BED format
   159	    4. bedtools slop adds 1000bp padding
   160	    """
   161	    input:
   162	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/initial.vcf.gz",

   166	    wildcard_constraints:

   168	    log:
   169	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.hybrid_select.log",
   170	    threads: config['sentdhuo']['threads']

   177	        threads=192,
   178	        vcpu=192,
   179	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
   180	    params:
   181	        use_threads=config["sentdhuo"]["use_threads"],
   182	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   183	        slop_size=1000,
   184	    shell:
   185	        """
   186	        set -euo pipefail
   187	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   188	
   189	        echo "Starting hybrid_select pipeline at $(date)" >> {log}
   190	
   191	        # Find hybrid_select.py script
   192	        HYBRID_SELECT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('hybrid_select.py'))")
   193	
   194	        # Pipeline: hybrid_select.py -> bcftools view -> bcftools query -> bedtools slop
   195	        # This replicates sentieon-cli's cmd_pyexec_hybrid_select() function
   196	        sentieon pyexec "$HYBRID_SELECT" \
   197	            -v {input.vcf} \
   198	            -t {params.use_threads} \
   199	            - 2>> {log} \
   200	        | bcftools view -f 'PASS,.' - 2>> {log} \
   201	        | bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS0\t%END\n' - 2>> {log} \
   202	        | bedtools slop -b {params.slop_size} -g {input.ref_fai} -i - \

   205	        echo "hybrid_select pipeline completed at $(date)" >> {log}

   328	rule sentdhupm_stage1:

   330	    input:

   337	        hap_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/stage1_hap.vcf",
   338	        ins_fa=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/stage1_ins.fa",
   339	        ins_bed=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/stage1_ins.bed",
   340	    wildcard_constraints:
   341	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHUPM)
   342	    log:
   343	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.stage1.log",
   344	    threads: config['sentdhuo']['threads']
   345	    conda:
   346	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   347	    benchmark:
   348	        MDIR + "{sample}/benchmarks/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.sentdhupm.{dchrm}.stage1.bench.tsv"
   349	    resources:
   350	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   351	        threads=192,
   352	        vcpu=192,
   353	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
   354	    params:
   355	        huref=config["supporting_files"]["files"]["huref"]["fasta"]["name"],
   356	        model=config["sentdhuo"]["dna_scope_snv_model"],
   357	        use_threads=config["sentdhuo"]["use_threads"],
   358	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   359	        alt_samp_name=get_alt_sample_name,
   360	    shell:
   361	        r"""
   362	        set -euo pipefail
   363	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   364	
   365	        timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S);
   366	        export TMPDIR="/dev/shm/sentdhupm_s1_${{timestamp}}_$$";
   367	        export SENTIEON_TMPDIR="$TMPDIR";
   368	        mkdir -p "$TMPDIR";
   369	        if [ ! -d "$TMPDIR" ]; then
   370	            echo "ERROR: Failed to create TMPDIR: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   371	            exit 5;
   372	        fi
   373	        echo "TMPDIR created: $TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   374	        ls -ld "$TMPDIR" >> {log} 2>&1;
   375	        df -h /dev/shm >> {log} 2>&1;
   376	        export APPTAINER_HOME="$TMPDIR";

   378	
   379	        echo "Starting Stage 1 at $(date)" >> {log}
   380	
   381	        # Use cluster_sample for consistent @RG SM tag across entire pipeline

   383	        epocsec=$(date +%s)

   744	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   745	# Rule 13: Transfer - Annotation transfer from population VCF (if pop_vcf set)
   746	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   747	rule sentdhupm_transfer:
   748	    """Transfer annotations from population VCF using bcftools merge"""
   749	    input:
   750	        anno_vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_anno.vcf.gz",
   751	    output:
   752	        vcf=MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/vcfs/{dchrm}/tmp/combined_tmp_transfer.vcf.gz",
   753	    wildcard_constraints:
   754	        alnr="|".join(ALIGNERS_DHUPM)
   755	    log:
   756	        MDIR + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhupm/log/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.{dchrm}.transfer.log",
   757	    threads: config['sentdhuo']['threads']
   758	    conda:
   759	        "../envs/sentieon_v0.3.yaml"
   760	    resources:
   761	        partition="i192mem,i192bigmem",
   762	        threads=192,
   763	        vcpu=192,
   764	        mem_mb=config['sentdhuo']['mem_mb'],
   765	    params:
   766	        pop_vcf=config["sentdhuo"]["pop_vcf"],
   767	        use_threads=config["sentdhuo"]["use_threads"],
   768	        cluster_sample=ret_sample,
   769	    shell:
   770	        """
   771	        set -euo pipefail
   772	        export PATH=$PATH:/fsx/data/cached_envs/sentieon-genomics-202503.02/bin/
   773	
   774	        echo "Starting annotation transfer at $(date)" >> {log}
   775	
   776	        TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
   777	
   778	        # Reheader anno_vcf to use cluster_sample name (use old\tnew format)
   779	        anno_old_sample=$(bcftools query -l {input.anno_vcf} | head -n1)
   780	        echo "Anno VCF original sample: $anno_old_sample, target sample: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log}
   781	        echo -e "${{anno_old_sample}}\t{params.cluster_sample}" > "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   782	        bcftools reheader -s "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {input.anno_vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   783	        bcftools index -t "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" >> {log} 2>&1
   784	
   785	        # If pop_vcf is set and non-empty, do annotation transfer; otherwise just copy
   786	        # Note: pop_vcf is a sites-only VCF (no samples) - don't try to reheader it
   787	        if [ -n "{params.pop_vcf}" ] && [ -f "{params.pop_vcf}" ]; then
   788	            TRIM_SCRIPT=$(python -c "from importlib_resources import files; print(files('sentieon_cli.scripts').joinpath('trimalt.py'))")
   789	
   790	            echo "Transferring annotations from pop_vcf: {params.pop_vcf}" >> {log}
   791	
   792	            # bcftools merge transfers INFO annotations from sites-only pop_vcf to sample VCF
   793	            # Then trimalt processes the merged output
   794	            bcftools merge --no-version --regions-overlap pos -m all \
   795	                "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {params.pop_vcf} 2>> {log} | \
   796	            sentieon pyexec "$TRIM_SCRIPT" 2>> {log} | \
   797	            bgzip -c -@ {params.use_threads} > {output.vcf} 2>> {log}
   798	
   799	            # Create tabix index
   800	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   801	
   802	            # Cleanup temp files
   803	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" \
   804	                  "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   805	        else
   806	            echo "No pop_vcf configured, using reheadered anno VCF directly" >> {log}
   807	            mv "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz" {output.vcf}
   808	            bcftools index -t {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
   809	            rm -f "$TMPDIR/anno_reheadered.vcf.gz.tbi" "$TMPDIR/anno_rename.txt"
   810	        fi
   811	
   812	        echo "Transfer completed at $(date)" >> {log}
   813	        """

# Conversation Summary

## 1. Previous Conversation

The conversation began with a request to replace hardcoded resource values (`threads=192` and `vcpu=192`) in modular hybrid Sentieon rule files with config-based dynamic values. Six files were modified to reference appropriate config keys (e.g., `config['sentdhio']['threads']`) instead of hardcoded values, allowing flexible resource allocation across different execution profiles (local vs slurm). A Python script performed 202 replacements across all files.

After completing the hardcoded resource replacement, the user asked about the status of hybrid-cli ILMN+ONT and Ultima+ONT tests running on headnode `44.231.76.175`. The assistant found that ILMN+ONT tests completed successfully, but Ultima+ONT tests failed on the `sentdhuo_snv` rule with a `MissingOutputException`.

## 2. Current Work

The assistant investigated the Ultima+ONT CLI failure and identified the root cause: The `sentdhuo_snv` rule in `sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk` declares a `.vcf.tmp` output file that is never created by sentieon-cli. The sentieon-cli command completes successfully and produces the `.vcf.gz` file, but Snakemake fails because it expects the `.vcf.tmp` file.

The fix was applied by wrapping the `.vcf.tmp` output in Snakemake's `touch()` function in both `sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk` and `sent_hybrid_ug_pb.smk`. The changes were committed and pushed to the `feat/modular-hybrid-workflows` branch.

Following the fix, the user requested to "commit and push" and then "start brand new hybrid tests for ILMN+ONT and UG+ONT both cli and modular, from tmux sessions onwards". The assistant:

1. Committed and pushed the `.vcf.tmp` fix (commit `ad4d037`)
2. Created a launch script that used `day-clone` to create 4 new analysis directories on the headnode
3. Copied config files (samples.tsv and units.tsv) from existing test directories
4. Launched 4 tmux sessions with the appropriate dy-r targets

The 4 tests launched are:
- `t3-hybrid-cli-ilmn-ont-3x`: CLI ILMN+ONT on hg38, target `produce_sentdhio_vcf`
- `t3-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x`: Modular ILMN+ONT on hg38, target `produce_sentdhiom_vcf`
- `t3-hybrid-cli-ug-ont-3x`: CLI UG+ONT on hg38_broad, target `produce_sentdhuo_vcf`
- `t3-hybrid-mod-ug-ont-3x`: Modular UG+ONT on hg38_broad, target `produce_sentdhuom_vcf`

The user then asked "how are the jobs going?" and the assistant checked the status. The modular ILMN+ONT session appears to have completed or exited (showing `RETURN CODE: 0` and back at prompt), while the other sessions show submitted jobs. The slurm queue is currently empty.

## 3. Key Technical Concepts

- **Snakemake workflow management**: Rules with `resources:` sections defining computational resource requirements
- **Config-based resource allocation**: Using `config['key']['threads']` instead of hardcoded values
- **Sentieon hybrid variant calling workflows**: Modular and CLI-based rules for different sequencing technology combinations
- **Snakemake output validation**: Rules must produce all declared output files or use `touch()` for placeholder files
- **MissingOutputException**: Snakemake error when expected output files are not created after job completion
- **AWS ParallelCluster headnodes**: Remote execution environment for pipeline testing
- **day-clone**: Daylily CLI tool for cloning analysis repositories into FSx workspace
- **dyoainit**: Script to initialize daylily analysis directory
- **dy-a**: Alias for `source bin/day_activate` to activate execution environment
- **dy-r**: Alias for `source bin/day_run` to run snakemake with configured profile
- **tmux session management**: Using tmux for persistent remote sessions
- **Genome builds**: hg38 (for ILMN+ONT), hg38_broad (for UG+ONT)
- **Sentieon-cli dnascope-hybrid**: Command-line interface for hybrid variant calling
- **GIAB concordance metrics**: F-score, Recall, Precision for variant calling quality assessment

## 4. Relevant Files and Code

### Modified Files (Hardcoded Resource Replacement):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhio`
  - 34 resource-level replacements (17 threads + 17 vcpu) + 1 rule-level replacement
  - Pattern: `threads=192,` → `threads=config['sentdhio']['threads'],`
  - Pattern: `vcpu=192,` → `vcpu=config['sentdhio']['threads'],`

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhuo`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhuo`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhipm`
  - 34 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhrom`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhrpm`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

### Fixed Files (Ultima+ONT CLI Failure):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk** (line 17-18)
  - Issue: Declared `.vcf.tmp` output that was never created by sentieon-cli
  - Fix applied:
  ```python
  tvcf=touch(MDIR
      + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhuo/vcfs/{dchrm}/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.sentdhuo.{dchrm}.snv.vcf.tmp"),
  ```
  - Changed from `temp()` to `touch()` so Snakemake creates the file automatically on success

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb.smk** (line 26-27)
  - Issue: Same as above for `sentdhup`
  - Fix applied:
  ```python
  tvcf=touch(MDIR
      + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhup/vcfs/{dchrm}/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.sentdhup.{dchrm}.snv.vcf.tmp"),
  ```

### Config Files (Verified, No Changes):

- **config/day_profiles/local/templates/rule_config.yaml**
  - Contains: `sentdhio: {threads: 7}`, `sentdhuo: {threads: 7}`, `sentdhipm: {threads: 7}`, `sentdhrom: {threads: 7}`, `sentdhrpm: {threads: 7}`

- **config/day_profiles/slurm/templates/rule_config.yaml**
  - Contains: `sentdhio: {threads: 192}`, `sentdhuo: {threads: 192}`, `sentdhipm: {threads: 192}`, `sentdhrom: {threads: 192}`, `sentdhrpm: {threads: 192}`

### Test Configuration Files:

Sample configuration pattern (from test-hybrid-cli-ug-ont-3x):
- **config/samples.tsv**: HG003 sample with GIAB truth data paths
- **config/units.tsv**: Specifies CRAM paths for Ultima (UG) and ONT data

## 5. Problem Solving

### Hardcoded Resource Replacement (Completed):
- **Problem**: Hardcoded `threads=192` and `vcpu=192` values in modular hybrid rules prevented flexible resource allocation
- **Solution**: Created Python script to replace all occurrences with config-based references
- **Verification**: Used `grep` to confirm zero remaining hardcoded values
- **Result**: 202 total replacements across 6 files

### Ultima+ONT CLI Failure (Fixed):
- **Problem**: `sentdhuo_snv` rule fails with `MissingOutputException` for `.vcf.tmp` file
- **Root Cause**: The rule declares `tvcf` output (`.vcf.tmp`) but sentieon-cli only produces `.vcf.gz`
- **Evidence**: Log shows sentieon-cli completed successfully, producing the expected `.vcf.gz` file, but Snakemake waits 100 seconds for the missing `.vcf.tmp` file before failing
- **Affected Files**: `sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk` and `sent_hybrid_ug_pb.smk`
- **Solution Applied**: Wrapped `.vcf.tmp` output in `touch()` function instead of `temp()`
- **Commit**: `ad4d037` - "Fix MissingOutputException: wrap .vcf.tmp output in touch() for hybrid CLI UG rules"

### Test Launch Issues (Resolved):
- **Problem**: Initial tmux session launches used chained commands with `&&`, but `dy-a` (which sources a script with `return`) doesn't work in `&&` chains, and `dy-r` uses `exit` which kills the shell
- **Solution**: Sent commands sequentially to tmux sessions instead of chaining, and set `remain-on-exit on` for CLI sessions to prevent shell death after `dy-r` exits
- **Problem**: Initial CLI test runs used wrong target (`produce_snv_concordances` instead of `produce_sentdhio_vcf`/`produce_sentdhuo_vcf`)
- **Solution**: Recreated CLI sessions and launched with correct VCF production targets

  - **Stage 1**: Insertion detection + haplotype assembly → bwa realignment
  - **Stage 2**: Generate unmap/alt BAMs and refined BED
  - **Stage 3**: Re-alignment with stage2 outputs (HybridStage3 on all reads)
  - **Pass 2**: Second-pass variant calling on refined regions using stage3 BAM + original LR reads
  - **Subset**: Subset pass-1 VCF to complement of stage2 regions
  - **Merge**: Combine pass2 and subset VCFs
  - **Filter/Norm**: Final filtering and normalization
- **Read group conflicts**: Sentieon driver fails when the same RG ID appears in multiple input BAMs with different attributes (SM, LB, PL, etc.)
- **BAM reheadering**: Using `samtools view -H | sed | samtools reheader` to modify @RG SM tags

Since stage3 is built from the ONT data, it inherits that mismatched sample name.

Yet that same concern would apply to roche+ONT, so I'm trying to understand why the reheadering was only added to UG+ONT.

Actually, the safest approach is to reheader both the ONT CRAM and the stage3_bam to ensure consistent SM tags across all inputs. This preserves the original intent of producing a single-sample VCF while fixing the RG conflict. With roche+ONT, the ONT CRAM and the ONT RG in stage3_bam would already share the same SM tag, so they'd be consistent without needing changes. The problem only happens when you change SM in one place but not the other.

So I'll fix the UG+ONT pass2 rule by also reheadering the stage3_bam, which is the targeted fix for this specific failure. Now I should check the other modular files to make sure they don't have similar issues.

# Conversation Summary

## 1. Previous Conversation

The conversation began with a request to replace hardcoded resource values (`threads=192` and `vcpu=192`) in modular hybrid Sentieon rule files with config-based dynamic values. Six files were modified to reference appropriate config keys (e.g., `config['sentdhio']['threads']`) instead of hardcoded values, allowing flexible resource allocation across different execution profiles (local vs slurm). A Python script performed 202 replacements across all files.

After completing the hardcoded resource replacement, the user asked about the status of hybrid-cli ILMN+ONT and Ultima+ONT tests running on headnode `44.231.76.175`. The assistant found that ILMN+ONT tests completed successfully, but Ultima+ONT tests failed on the `sentdhuo_snv` rule with a `MissingOutputException`.

The assistant investigated the Ultima+ONT CLI failure and identified the root cause: The `sentdhuo_snv` rule in `sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk` declares a `.vcf.tmp` output file that is never created by sentieon-cli. The sentieon-cli command completes successfully and produces the `.vcf.gz` file, but Snakemake fails because it expects the `.vcf.tmp` file. The fix was applied by wrapping the `.vcf.tmp` output in Snakemake's `touch()` function in both `sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk` and `sent_hybrid_ug_pb.smk`. The changes were committed and pushed to the `feat/modular-hybrid-workflows` branch (commit `ad4d037`).

Following the fix, the user requested to "commit and push" and then "start brand new hybrid tests for ILMN+ONT and UG+ONT both cli and modular, from tmux sessions onwards". The assistant created 4 new analysis directories on the headnode using `day-clone` and launched 4 tmux sessions with the appropriate dy-r targets.

## 2. Current Work

The assistant is currently managing 4 hybrid workflow tests on headnode `44.231.76.175`:

1. **t3-hybrid-cli-ilmn-ont-3x**: CLI ILMN+ONT test - submitted job 3 (jobid 4694), running `sentdhio_snv` rule
2. **t3-hybrid-cli-ug-ont-3x**: CLI UG+ONT test - submitted job 4 (jobid 4695), running `sentdhuo_snv` rule (critical test for the `touch()` fix)
3. **t3-hybrid-mod-ug-ont-3x**: Modular UG+ONT test - **FAILED** on `sentdhuom_pass2` rule with error: `Readgroup 70eb6e24... with different attributes is present in multiple bam files: ont_pass2_reheadered.bam, hybrid_stage3.bam. Error: Invalid input BAM files`
4. **t4-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x**: Modular ILMN+ONT test (relaunched with trim_head fix) - running, 4/24 steps (17%) complete

### Recent Issues Discovered and Fixed:

**Issue 1: Missing `trim_head` parameter in `sentdhiom_sr_align` rule (SOLVED)**
- The original `t3-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x` test failed immediately with `AttributeError: 'Params' object has no attribute 'trim_head'`
- The `sentdhiom_sr_align` shell command referenced `{params.trim_head}` but the params section was missing the definition
- Fixed by adding `trim_head=get_ilmn_trim_head,` to the params section (line 78 of `sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk`)
- Committed and pushed as commit `e107f56`
- Relaunched as `t4-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x` with the fix, now progressing successfully

**Issue 2: Conflicting read group attributes in `sentdhuom_pass2` rule (JUST FIXED)**
- The `t3-hybrid-mod-ug-ont-3x` test failed on the `sentdhuom_pass2` rule
- Error: `Readgroup 70eb6e24d3fa466002d6394f3ad558a46ab22393_dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v5.0.0 with different attributes is present in multiple bam files`
- Root cause: The rule reheaders the ONT CRAM to change the SM tag to match `cluster_sample`, but the `hybrid_stage3.bam` (which includes ONT reads processed through stage1/stage2/stage3) retains the original ONT read group ID with different attributes
- When sentieon driver tries to use both `-i ont_pass2_reheadered.bam -i hybrid_stage3.bam`, it detects the same RG ID with conflicting attributes and fails
- The ILMN+ONT modular workflow (`sentdhiom_pass2`) does NOT reheader the ONT CRAM - it passes it directly to sentieon driver alongside stage3_bam (lines 724-731 of `sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk`)
- **FIX APPLIED**: Modified `sentdhuom_pass2` rule to also reheader the `stage3_bam` with the same SM substitution, ensuring both input BAMs have identical RG attributes for shared read group IDs
- Committed and pushed as commit `9426248`
- **NEXT STEP**: Need to relaunch modular UG+ONT test with the fix

## 3. Key Technical Concepts

- **Snakemake workflow management**: Rules with `resources:` sections defining computational resource requirements
- **Config-based resource allocation**: Using `config['key']['threads']` instead of hardcoded values
- **Sentieon hybrid variant calling workflows**: Modular and CLI-based rules for different sequencing technology combinations
- **Snakemake output validation**: Rules must produce all declared output files or use `touch()` for placeholder files
- **MissingOutputException**: Snakemake error when expected output files are not created after job completion
- **AWS ParallelCluster headnodes**: Remote execution environment for pipeline testing
- **day-clone**: Daylily CLI tool for cloning analysis repositories into FSx workspace (usage: `day-clone -d <destination> -t <git-tag>`)
- **dyoainit**: Script to initialize daylily analysis directory
- **dy-a**: Alias for `source bin/day_activate` to activate execution environment (uses `return`, doesn't work in `&&` chains)
- **dy-r**: Alias for `source bin/day_run` to run snakemake with configured profile (uses `exit`, must be last in command chain)
- **tmux session management**: Using tmux for persistent remote sessions; `remain-on-exit on` prevents session death after shell exit
- **Genome builds**: hg38 (for ILMN+ONT), hg38_broad (for UG+ONT)
- **Sentieon-cli dnascope-hybrid**: Command-line interface for hybrid variant calling
- **Sentieon modular hybrid workflow stages**:
  - **Pass 1**: Initial variant calling on SR+LR reads
  - **MAPQ0 detection/slop**: Identify and extend low-quality mapping regions
  - **Stage 1**: Insertion detection + haplotype assembly → bwa realignment
  - **Stage 2**: Generate unmap/alt BAMs and refined BED
  - **Stage 3**: Re-alignment with stage2 outputs (HybridStage3 on all reads)
  - **Pass 2**: Second-pass variant calling on refined regions using stage3 BAM + original LR reads
  - **Subset**: Subset pass-1 VCF to complement of stage2 regions
  - **Merge**: Combine pass2 and subset VCFs
  - **Filter/Norm**: Final filtering and normalization
- **Read group conflicts**: Sentieon driver fails when the same RG ID appears in multiple input BAMs with different attributes (SM, LB, PL, etc.)
- **BAM reheadering**: Using `samtools view -H | sed | samtools reheader` to modify @RG SM tags

## 4. Relevant Files and Code

### Modified Files (Hardcoded Resource Replacement - COMPLETED):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhio`
  - 34 resource-level replacements (17 threads + 17 vcpu) + 1 rule-level replacement
  - Pattern: `threads=192,` → `threads=config['sentdhio']['threads'],`

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhuo`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhuo`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhipm`
  - 34 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_ont_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhrom`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_roche_pb_modular.smk**
  - Config key: `sentdhrpm`
  - 32 resource-level replacements + 1 rule-level replacement

### Fixed Files (CLI .vcf.tmp MissingOutputException - COMPLETED):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont.smk** (line 17-18)
  - Issue: Declared `.vcf.tmp` output that was never created by sentieon-cli
  - Fix applied (commit `ad4d037`):
  ```python
  tvcf=touch(MDIR
      + "{sample}/align/{alnr}/{ddup}/snv/sentdhuo/vcfs/{dchrm}/{sample}.{alnr}.{ddup}.sentdhuo.{dchrm}.snv.vcf.tmp"),
  ```
  - Changed from `temp()` to `touch()` so Snakemake creates the file automatically on success

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_pb.smk** (line 26-27)
  - Same fix for `sentdhup`

### Fixed Files (Missing trim_head Parameter - COMPLETED):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk** (line 78)
  - Issue: `sentdhiom_sr_align` shell command references `{params.trim_head}` but params section was missing the definition
  - Fix applied (commit `e107f56`):
  ```python
  params:
      huref=config["supporting_files"]["files"]["huref"]["fasta"]["name"],
      max_mem="130G"
      if "max_mem" not in config["sentieon"]
      else config["sentieon"]["max_mem"],
      model=config["sentdhio"]["dna_scope_snv_model"],
      use_threads=config["sentdhio"]["use_threads"],
      bwa_threads=config["sentieon"]["bwa_threads"],
      igz=config['sentieon']['igz'],
      mbuffer=config['sentieon']['mbuffer'],
      sort_thread_mem=config['sentieon']['sort_thread_mem'],
      sort_threads=config['sentieon']['sort_threads'],
      cluster_sample=ret_sample,
      trim_head=get_ilmn_trim_head,  # <-- ADDED THIS LINE
  ```

### Fixed Files (Read Group Conflict - JUST COMPLETED):

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ug_ont_modular.smk** (lines 605-632)
  - **`sentdhuom_pass2` rule**: Fixed to reheader both ONT CRAM and stage3_bam
  - Commit `9426248`
  ```python
  # Reheader ONT CRAM and stage3 BAM to use consistent sample name
  # Both must have identical RG attributes for shared read group IDs,
  # otherwise sentieon driver rejects the inputs as "Invalid input BAM files"
  TMPDIR=$(dirname {output.vcf})
  echo "Reheadering ONT CRAM to use sample name: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log} 2>&1
  samtools view -H {input.ont_cram} | \
      sed "s/SM:[^\\t]*/SM:{params.cluster_sample}/g" > "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_header.txt"
  samtools reheader "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_header.txt" {input.ont_cram} > "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_reheadered.bam"
  samtools index -@ {params.use_threads} "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_reheadered.bam" >> {log} 2>&1

  echo "Reheadering stage3 BAM to use sample name: {params.cluster_sample}" >> {log} 2>&1
  samtools view -H {input.stage3_bam} | \
      sed "s/SM:[^\\t]*/SM:{params.cluster_sample}/g" > "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_header.txt"
  samtools reheader "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_header.txt" {input.stage3_bam} > "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_reheadered.bam"
  samtools index -@ {params.use_threads} "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_reheadered.bam" >> {log} 2>&1

  sentieon driver -r {params.huref} -t {params.use_threads} \
      -i "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_reheadered.bam" -i "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_reheadered.bam" \
      --interval {input.bed} \
      {params.diploid_bed} \
      --algo DNAscope \
      --model {params.model}/hybrid.model \
      --pcr_indel_model none \
      {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1

  # Cleanup temp files
  rm -f "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_header.txt" "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_reheadered.bam" "$TMPDIR/ont_pass2_reheadered.bam.bai"
  rm -f "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_header.txt" "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_reheadered.bam" "$TMPDIR/stage3_pass2_reheadered.bam.bai"
  ```

- **workflow/rules/sent_hybrid_ilmn_ont_modular.smk** (lines 724-731)
  - **`sentdhiom_pass2` rule**: Does NOT reheader - passes ONT CRAM directly (this is the correct pattern)
  ```python

  sentieon driver -r {params.huref} -t {params.use_threads} \
      -i {input.lr_cram} -i {input.stage3_bam} \
      --interval {input.bed} \
      {params.diploid_bed} \
      --algo DNAscope \
      --model {params.model}/hybrid.model \
      --pcr_indel_model none \
      {output.vcf} >> {log} 2>&1
  ```

### Created Files:

  - Clones fresh analysis dir from `feat/modular-hybrid-workflows` branch

- **Solution Applied**: Wrapped `.vcf.tmp` output in `touch()` function instead of `temp()`
- **Commit**: `ad4d037` - "Fix MissingOutputException: wrap .vcf.tmp output in touch() for hybrid CLI UG rules"

### Problem 3: Missing trim_head Parameter (SOLVED)
- **Problem**: `t3-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x` test failed immediately with `AttributeError: 'Params' object has no attribute 'trim_head'`
- **Root Cause**: `sentdhiom_sr_align` shell command (lines 149-150) references `{params.trim_head}` but the params section (lines 65-77) was missing the definition
- **Solution**: Added `trim_head=get_ilmn_trim_head,` to params section at line 78
- **Commit**: `e107f56` - "Fix AttributeError: add missing trim_head param to sentdhiom_sr_align rule"
- **Verification**: Relaunched as `t4-hybrid-mod-ilmn-ont-3x`, now progressing (4/24 steps, 17%)

- **Problem**: `t3-hybrid-mod-ug-ont-3x` test failed on `sentdhuom_pass2` rule with error:

- **Solution Applied**: Modified `sentdhuom_pass2` to also reheader the `stage3_bam` with the same SM substitution, ensuring both input BAMs have identical RG attributes for shared read group IDs
- **Commit**: `9426248` - "Fix RG conflict in sentdhuom_pass2: reheader stage3 BAM alongside ONT CRAM"
